extraction.Name: Frank Sully
extraction.Refused/Protested: Yes I told the Sup't. before the patent was issued that I did not want mine. His answer was that we had to take them.
extraction.Recorded patent: it was sent to me by mail
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: I paid some $400 taxes out of it
extraction.NOTES: Sold allotment for $5500.00; sold some other land at the same time and both brought $11,000; paid approximately $400 in taxes out of proceeds; was satisfied with sale as he would have eventually lost it; received a cattle loan before the patent was issued; not in good health; wife and two children depend on him for support; document notarized by Jas. W. Cross, Notary Public, commission expires 4-28-32, on May 7, 1929
